existing_proofs_preserved: Complete forward chunk loop, triangular dot, carry sum/update, fp32 input conversion and typed output store are represented for symbolic floating source/output types. Public Real IO proves each column prefix with frame; the sum-left candidate retains explicit FP scalar assumptions. RealPadding.source_outputs establishes active prefixes independently of arbitrary time/feature padding.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Full time loop and every active feature in one selected feature/head program are covered.
Shape unpacking, dtype default/override, empty_like and grid (ceil(S/32), B*H) remain uncomposed.

dtype_review: The source explicitly converts loaded values to fp32 and output to pointer element type, but materialized dtype/out_dtype are FloatDType only. No wrapper admission/rejection contract connects nonfloating torch.dtype overrides to the formal scope.
branch_review: T=0, positive BT, complete/partial time and feature tiles are already represented; the i_t>=0 condition and all autotuned mathematical BT choices are retained. No missing-tail-loop claim is made.

structural_gaps.finding: The wrapper selects dtype or s.dtype, allocates z and launches all head/feature programs, while the public IO is one program indexed by feature/head.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The exact returned BxHxTxS tensor, source strides and two dtype-selection branches have no wrapper composition theorem.

structural_gaps.finding: TypedSource uses FloatDType for both storage arguments; the wrapper does not impose that restriction.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: Supported nonfloating load/store conversions need a represented route or an explicit original admission/rejection boundary before numerical casts can be deferred.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Dot/reduction schedules, fp32 carry addition and represented source/output casts are numerical follow-up items. Padding independence is already proved for active Real outputs; do not invent a zero-padding assumption.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
